title: Feasibility and Effectiveness of Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy in Inflammatory Breast Cancer
official: Feasibility and Effectiveness of Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy in Inflammatory Breast Cancer
summary: This study is for participants with inflammatory breast cancer (IBC). The purpose of this study is to find out whether it is possible to take a sample of underarm lymph nodes for participants with IBC. The participants will undergo sentinel lymph node biopsy (SLNB) in addition to full axillary lymph node dissection (ALND) during the planned breast cancer surgery. Participants enrolled in the study will first be injected with tracer, then undergo SLNB, and then undergo full ALND.

interventions.name: Sentinel node biopsy with blue dye and radioisotope

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult participants greater than 18 years old
* Diagnosed with inflammatory breast cancer
* Completion of course of Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy
* Surgery completed at Cleveland Clinic

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participant is pregnant at the time of surgery

  * Pregnant participants will be excluded from participation in the study as injection of blue dye to aid in identification of sentinel lymph nodes is contraindicated in pregnancy due to the risk of fetal harm.
  * Metastatic disease at the time of diagnosis or diagnosed prior to surgical treatment
